Anger Management...

October 06, 2005

Arrgh… [Song in ears :: wonderwall - oasis :: feel nostalgic] With all the anger still pented up inside, i am searching for a way to ooze out. Where..? Where?? I have already blasted of all the friends i could lay my sight upon. Sad.
I need to channel it right; it’s eating me inside. I am not happy at home, i am not happy at office? What is it?
[for fucking christ sake, can’t i just get one good song]
[song :: with or without you - u2 :: extreme depression]
This song has a history with me. I have never got bored with this song. I have listened it for days and days, until they were weeks and then months and
now years! I haven’t got bored of this song in last 6 years. It’s just too fucking awesome.
oooooo..ss…ooooooooooosss….sss..ooooooooooosss…..sss..ooooooooooooo with or without you ssssss…..ahhhh..haaaa……. with or without you…
sssss…..i can’t live…with or…….

Lets get a grip and oozee out.
“fuck you”
[Louder] “Fuck YOU” [better]
[now one last time] “FUCK YOU ALL”
………………………………………………………………as i said earlier NIRVANA!
